details.text: CodeSystem Supplements SHALL have a content value of 'supplement'
The code 'test' is not declared in the base CodeSystem http://loinc.org so is not valid in the supplement
HL7 Defined CodeSystems should ensure that every concept has a definition
The supplement does not say what language it is in (CodeSystem.language), so the displays and designations in it that have no language (1) are considered correct displays in all languages
